fields.description:
Revise the T10 (overlay-infra) rubric to partition its durable-infrastructure scope away from transient de-risk experiments. There is no runtime cross-criterion suppression by design, so the boundary must live in the T10 rubric text.

## Work
- Edit `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T10.md`: add this scope clause near the top: "This overlay evaluates the DURABLE infrastructure — the IaC/config that persists. Transient, throwaway experiments used to de-risk a mechanism before committing it — their creation, isolation, and teardown — are out of scope here."
- Immediately after that scope clause, add this exact co-located safety qualifier: "This exclusion does NOT waive b2: an internet- or untrusted-network-reachable service (even a transient one) whose human/admin authentication is unspecified is still an under-specified endpoint-access contract — flag it."
- Keep the rubric independent: T10 must not name T15 or assign scope to another overlay.
- Add a packaged live eval corpus at `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/plan-review-T10.eval.yaml`. Its dataset has two must-not-fire cases (an explicitly throwaway loopback/private probe with scoped teardown; fully specified durable infrastructure) and two must-fire controls (under-specified durable lifecycle safety; an untrusted-network-reachable transient service with unspecified authentication). Add a balanced `gold_set` with one condensed `input` plus `label` item matching each of those four dataset scenarios: two `pass` labels and two `finding` labels, following the sibling packaged plan-review specs.
- Add offline shape and text-contract tests in `tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py`; these lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, rubric independence, and the four balanced dataset and gold-set labels. Agentic finding behavior is proved separately by the live criterion eval, not by these unit tests.
- Regenerate `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` from the registry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The T10 rubric contains the exact durable-infrastructure scope clause.
- [ ] The exact b2 safety qualifier appears immediately after the scope clause.
- [ ] The T10 rubric does not name T15.
- [ ] The T10 rubric does not assign scope to another overlay.
- [ ] The packaged eval spec contains four dataset cases and a matching balanced four-item `gold_set`, each split into two `pass` and two `finding` labels, and passes strict packaged-spec validation.
- [ ] The offline tests in `tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py` pass and assert the exact scope clause, exact b2 qualifier, absence of any T15 reference, and the balanced dataset and gold-set labels.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the scoped throwaway private-probe case.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the fully specified durable-infrastructure case.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the under-specified durable-lifecycle case.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the untrusted-network transient-service case.
- [ ] `rebar explain T10` renders the durable-infrastructure scope clause and co-located b2 safety qualifier.
- [ ] The regenerated T10 section in `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` renders the durable-infrastructure scope clause and co-located b2 safety qualifier.

## Testing
- Run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py tests/unit/test_new_eval_specs.py -q`.
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3`.
- Run `.venv/bin/python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide`.
- Run `.venv/bin/python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing`.
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar explain T10` and verify the rendered clause and qualifier.
